messages.content: Under the supplied Indian safeguards, may an arrested person insist on a lawyer throughout every minute of interrogation?

lawCards.title: Arrest safeguards include access to information and help
lawCards.text: BNSS section 38 allows an arrested person to meet an advocate during interrogation, though not throughout it. Section 47 concerns communication of grounds for arrest without warrant; section 48 concerns informing a nominated relative, friend or other person of the arrest and place of custody.
lawCards.hi: BNSS की धारा 38 गिरफ्तारी के बाद पूछताछ के दौरान वकील से मिलने का अधिकार देती है, लेकिन पूरी पूछताछ के दौरान नहीं। धारा 47 बिना वारंट गिरफ्तारी के आधार बताने और धारा 48 नामित व्यक्ति को गिरफ्तारी व हिरासत की जगह की जानकारी देने से संबंधित है.
lawCards.caution: A lawyer must check applicability, territorial exceptions and transitional provisions. No automatic entitlement to bail or prediction about arrest is made.
